definition: with a light clicking or tapping sound.
example_en: The door made a light tapping sound.

definition: a broken piece of an arrow.
example: ಬಾಣ ಗುರಿ ತಪ್ಪಿ ಶರಭಂಗವಾಗಿ ನೆಲಕ್ಕೆ ಬಿದ್ದಿತು.
example_en: The arrow missed its mark and fell to the ground as a broken piece.

definition: a place covered or abounding with grass; a grassy place.
example_en: The cattle were grazing in the grassy place.

definition: a platform on the bastion that gives a wider range for a firing artilleries.
example: ಕೋಟೆಯ ಮೋರ್ಚೆಯಿಂದ ಶತ್ರುಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಗುಂಡು ಹಾರಿಸಲಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Shots were fired at the enemies from the fort's bastion platform.

definition: an chisel-like arrow.
example_en: The hunter shot the boar with a chisel-like arrow.

definition: a thorny bush.
example_en: That thorny bush had grown all along the field's fence.

definition: the act of cheating, deceiving; deception.
example_en: I suffered a loss because of his deception.

definition: to tremble, quiver from fear.
example_en: He trembled with fear.

definition: (pl.) two folds (of a cloth, paper, etc.).
example_en: They arranged and kept the two folds of the cloth together.

definition: to brighten by or as by rubbing; to polish.
example: ಕಮ್ಮಾರ ಕತ್ತಿಯ ಅಲಗನ್ನು ಕಲ್ಲಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಮಸೆದನು.
example_en: The blacksmith polished the blade of the knife on the stone.

definition: that which is mountain-born.
example_en: Parvati is also called the mountain-born one.

definition: propagation of knowledge; a giving of education for a large number of students.
example: ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಪ್ರದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿದ್ಯಾಪ್ರಸಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಒತ್ತು ನೀಡಿತು.
example_en: The government gave emphasis to the propagation of education in rural areas.

definition: to cause to stop.
example_en: The police stopped the quarrel and established peace.

definition: (sound) to be emitted.
example_en: Thunder sounded from a distance.

definition: always - a) at all times; on all occasions; b) all the time; continuously; forever.
example_en: She always wakes up early in the morning.

definition: extreme heat.
example_en: The extreme heat of the fire struck the face.

definition: that on which another relies; a support; a prop.
example_en: He himself was a support for the poor.

definition: to cause to feel fright; to fill with terror; to frighten; to terrify.
example_en: That frightening story terrified the children.

definition: to shine - a) to give forth or glow with light; to shed or cast light; b) to be bright with reflected light; to glisten; to sparkle.
example_en: At night, the fireflies were glowing and sparkling.

definition: by luck; luckily.
example_en: By luck, he escaped the accident.

definition: left; abandoned.
example_en: That old house had long been abandoned.

definition: the life principle; the state or property of a living being that distinguishes it from inorganic matter or dead organisms.
example_en: Life principle exists in every living being.

definition: a piece of land higher than adjacent land; a natural elevation of land.
example_en: They sat on the raised mound in the middle of the field.

definition: a holiday given to or availed by a person for working or having worked on another holiday or for extra hours; a compensatory holiday.
example: ಹಬ್ಬದ ದಿನ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದಕ್ಕೆ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಬದಲಿರಜೆ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿತು.
example_en: He got a compensatory holiday for working on the festival day.

definition: the urine of cattle.
example_en: They use cattle urine as manure for the field.

definition: to call; to call out; to shout.
example_en: He called out to his friend from a distance.

definition: an artisan who makes articles of gold; a gold-smith.
example: ಆ ವಸುವಿಭೇದಕ ಚಿನ್ನದ ಬಳೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸುಂದರವಾಗಿ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: That goldsmith made the gold bangles beautifully.

definition: a man of which type; a man of such and such a type.
example_en: What type of man are you looking for?

definition: absence or eradication of subconscious influences of the impressions of past experiences which would otherwise provoke the the feelings of love, hatred, greed, anger, biasedness, etc.
example: ಧ್ಯಾನದಿಂದ ಸಾಧಕನಿಗೆ ವಾಸನಾಕ್ಷಯ ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಗುರುಗಳು ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: The teacher said that through meditation the seeker attains eradication of subconscious impressions.

definition: ready; prepared.
example_en: We had kept all the materials ready.

definition: one of the seven mother-goddesses.
example_en: There was an idol of the goddess Cauḍi in the temple.

definition: any of various rapidly growing, fleshy fungi, typically having a stalk capped with an umbrella-like top, esp. a gill or pore fungus (some of which are edible such as Agaricus campestris of Agaricaceae family); a mushroom.
example_en: They used mushrooms for cooking.

definition: a platform on the bastion that gives a wider range for a firing artilleries.
example_en: The guards were closely watching the fort's bastion platform.

definition: a thing, a female animal or human being that can never produce an offspring.
example_en: It became known that the cow was completely barren.

definition: an authoritative regulation for action, conduct, method, procedure, arrangement, etc. or an established practice that serves as a guide to usage; a rule.
example_en: Everyone must follow the administration's rule.

definition: materials used to write on or with, as paper, pens, pencils, etc.
example_en: She bought writing materials from the shop.

definition: the eye that is large and round.
example_en: The old man's large round eye was filled with tears.

definition: great mental or physical pain; agony.
example: ಅವಳ ಮಗನ ಸಾವು ಅವಳಿಗೆ ನೊರಕೆ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: Her son's death brought her agony.

definition: a small tower or a room on the fort; a bastion.
example_en: The whole town could be seen from the fort's bastion.

definition: full off; filled with.
example_en: That vessel was full of milk.

definition: an illicit traffic in officially controlled or scarce commodities; a sale, transaction, that is outside the system regulated by the government (done in order to avoid paying tax on it and on the income from it).
example_en: The police arrested those doing illicit trade.

definition: to read (aloud).
example_en: The teacher read the letter aloud before everyone.

definition: a male cat.
example_en: The tomcat was searching for the female cat in the street.

definition: to make something very obvious.
example_en: The teacher made the truth very obvious to the disciples.

definition: to make damp; to moisten; to dampen.
example_en: The rain came and moistened the dried ground.

definition: the crazy behaviour caused by mental disorder.
example_en: Suddenly crazy, disordered behaviour appeared in his speech.

definition: to have the advantage of another's permissiveness, lenience.
example_en: He came late, taking advantage of the teacher's leniency.

definition: a material or materials needed commonly by common people, as grains, other food items, etc. sold in a store; goods.
example_en: They bought the month's groceries all at once.

definition: having or having covered with, skin.
example: ಚಾರ್ಮಣ ಪ್ರಾಣಿಗಳ ದೇಹ ರಕ್ಷಣೆಗೆ ಚರ್ಮ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Skin-covered animals have skin for the body's protection.

definition: the state or fact of coming out of sleep, stupor, trance etc.; the state of being or staying awake.
example_en: The mind felt light due to the morning wakefulness.

definition: a competent, capable woman.
example_en: The head of that company is a truly competent woman.

definition: to communicate, convey or direct by meaningful signals; to signal.
example_en: The guard signalled a warning from a distance.

definition: to shine brightly.
example_en: Those gems shone brightly in the sunlight.

definition: the bottom or under surface of the foot; the sole.
example_en: A thorn pricked the sole of his foot.

definition: the one hundredth anniversary of one's birth or its commemoration.
example_en: They celebrated the school's centenary with great festivity.

definition: a going on water in a boat as a pleasure-sport.
example: ರಜೆಯ ದಿನ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರೆಲ್ಲ ನಾವಾಟಕ್ಕೆ ಸರೋವರಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋದರು.
example_en: On the holiday, all the friends went boating on the lake.

definition: to decide; to take a firm decision.
example_en: He decided firmly to leave the town.

definition: the part of an army that goes ahead of the main body; vanguard.
example_en: The vanguard of the army reached the border first.

definition: a surname among Telugu speaking people.
example_en: Reddy is the headmaster of our school.

definition: a particular manner in which tāḷa mode in music.
example: ಅನುದ್ಗತವೃತ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ನುಡಿಸಿದಾಗ ತಾಳ ಸೊಗಸಾಗಿ ಮೂಡಿತು.
example_en: When the particular tala mode was played correctly, the rhythm emerged beautifully.

definition: a building or room designed and equipped for indoor exercise or physical training.
example_en: Soldiers practise every day in the training hall.

definition: the first cash sale of the day made by a seller.
example_en: The shop's first sale of the day fetched a good price.

definition: a kind of alcoholic liquor as rum, distilled from molasses.
example: ಅವನಿಗೆ ಸೀಧು ಎಂಬ ಮದ್ಯದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಒಲವಿತ್ತು.
example_en: He was fond of the liquor called sidhu.

definition: that cannot be imagined; unimaginable; contrary to reason.
example_en: Everyone said that his feat was unimaginable.

definition: the service of a body-guard.
example_en: The bodyguard service was provided to the king.

definition: the back bone of vertebral animals.
example: ಬೆನ್ನಿನ ಅಂಗದಂಡಿ ಕಶೇರುಕ ಪ್ರಾಣಿಗಳ ದೇಹಕ್ಕೆ ಆಧಾರ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The vertebrate's backbone provides support to its body.

definition: a superintendent overseeing a troupe of guards, policemen, etc.
example_en: The superintendent ordered the guards to go on patrol.

definition: the cassia plant Cassia tora of Caesalpiniaceae family; foetid cassia.
example_en: The foetid cassia plant grows abundantly during the rainy season.

definition: to pick out by preference from what is available; to take as a choice; to select; to choose.
example_en: She chose the good cloth.

definition: a long staff with a sickle hooked at one end.
example_en: The farmer cut the tree branches with the long hooked-sickle staff (aridōṭi).

definition: a man belonging to a caste the main profession of the members of which is trading and business.
example_en: There are many shops of komaṭiga (trader caste) men on that street.

definition: an uneven surface (having declivities and acclivities).
example_en: It is difficult to walk on that uneven surface.

definition: (faith, trustworthiness, etc.) to be convinced.
example_en: Hearing his words, the people were convinced.

definition: to cause to become different; to alter, transform, convert or change.
example_en: It is difficult to transform his nature.

definition: one of the eighteen minor purāṇas.
example_en: The glory of the Sun god is described in the Saura Purana.

definition: the rising sun; the morning-sun.
example_en: The light of the morning sun lit up the village.

definition: to decompose (oneself); to putrefy; to rot; to decay.
example_en: Fruits decompose quickly in a damp environment.

definition: the act or state of moving rapidly; swiftness; quick motion.
example_en: He ran with great speed and caught the bus.

definition: (one's hand) to become partially disabled.
example_en: His hand became partially disabled in the accident.

definition: the nature of one's body, its disposition, constitution, etc.
example_en: This medicine improved his bodily constitution.

definition: the spotless white colour.
example: ಬಟ್ಟೆಯ ಕಡುವಿಳಿದು ಬಣ್ಣ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The spotless white colour of the cloth attracted everyone's attention.

definition: (beauty) to become conspicuous.
example_en: After she decorated herself, her beauty became conspicuous.

definition: being under possession of; seized; captured.
example: ಆ ಹಳೆಯ ಮನೆ ಭೂತದ ಅಕ್ಕಾಂತವಾಗಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಜನ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: People say that old house is seized by a ghost.

definition: an oil lamp used by a devotee at the temple, as a vow, to get an impending danger warded off.
example: ಅಪಾಯ ತಪ್ಪಲೆಂದು ಅವನು ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಗಂಡದೀಪ ಹಚ್ಚಿದನು.
example_en: To ward off the danger, he lit a vow lamp at the temple.

definition: the tail of a cow.
example_en: The child caught the cow's tail and pulled it.

definition: to cut asunder.
example_en: He cut the rope asunder with a knife.

definition: monopoly - a) sole power or privilege, of dealing in something, as control of a commodity or service in a given market, fixing of prices, exclusive privilege of engaging in a particular business, etc.; b) exclusive command or possession; c) that of which one has such a sole privilege, command or possession.
example: ಆ ಕಂಪನಿ ಸಕ್ಕರೆ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಏಕಸ್ವಾಮ್ಯ ಸಾಧಿಸಿದೆ.
example_en: That company has achieved a monopoly in the sugar market.

definition: the child born of parents not married to each other.
example: ಅನೌರಸ ಸಂತಾನಕ್ಕೆ ಸಮಾಜದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲವೊಮ್ಮೆ ಕೀಳುನೋಟ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: A child born of parents not married to each other sometimes faces contempt in society.

definition: to join as husband and wife; unite in wedlock; to marry.
example_en: They married and began a new life together.

definition: to lose rhythm; to falter in keeping rhythm.
example_en: The singer kept losing rhythm because of the accompaniment's beat.

definition: born in southern side; of or belonging to, happening in or coming from south direction.
example_en: This plant has come from the southern region.

definition: any fever, disease that is caused by a wound in the body.
example_en: The disease caused by the wound made him suffer.

definition: to make (coins, money, etc.) by stamping metal; to mint.
example_en: They minted gold coins.

definition: cleaning; cleansing; detergent.
example: ಆ ಸೋಪು ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಧಾವಕ ಗುಣ ಹೊಂದಿದೆ.
example_en: That soap has good cleansing quality.

definition: (said of drinking) with a gulping sound.
example_en: He drank the milk with a gulping sound.

definition: a crying out loudly; a loud cry.
example_en: The child let out a loud cry in pain.

definition: a loan given by the governments to farmers for meeting expenses of raising crops, and related works.
example_en: The farmers received a crop loan from the government.

definition: of the Vedas; Vedic.
example_en: That scholar was an expert in Vedic learning.

definition: a legitimate offspring or offsprings.
example_en: He was happy to have a legitimate offspring.

definition: the act or sound of coughing; cough.
example_en: His cough did not stop the whole night.

definition: a noisy, petty quarrel or dispute; wrangle; squabble; bickering.
example: ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಕಚ್ಚುಕವನ್ನು ಅಮ್ಮ ಬೇಗ ಸಮಾಧಾನ ಮಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: The mother quickly settled the children's squabble.

definition: either of two equal parts into which a thing is divisible; a half.
example_en: He gave half of the sweet to his younger sister.

definition: a praising or glorification; adulation; favourable appreciation.
example_en: Everyone in the assembly praised him.

definition: to be burst open.
example_en: The door of the house was burst open by the storm.

definition: to wander about idly; to loiter; to loaf.
example_en: He was just loitering idly around the town.

definition: the act of helping; a support; assistance.
example_en: Giving assistance to the poor is a good deed.

definition: an act or an instance of stealing; theft; thievery.
example: ರಾತ್ರಿ ನಡೆದ ತುಡುಗಿನ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಊರಿನವರು ಮಾತನಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: The villagers talked about the theft that happened at night.

definition: to open the mouth involuntarily with a prolonged, deep inhalation and sighing or heavy exhalation, as from drowsiness or boredom; to yawn.
example: ಓದುತ್ತಾ ಕುಳಿತಿದ್ದ ಅವನು ನಿದ್ದೆ ಬಂದು ಜೃಂಭೆಗೆಯ್ದನು.
example_en: As he sat reading, he grew sleepy and yawned.

definition: any young animal.
example_en: A young animal was hiding in the forest.

definition: (said of opinion, wish, etc.) being in the mind; not expressed.
example_en: He did not tell anyone his unexpressed wish.

definition: caused by rain; rain-born.
example_en: The rain-born water filled the river and made it flow.

definition: the act of bending something or oneself (in reverence or submission).
example_en: They offered a bow to the god and began the worship.

definition: an acute infectious disease, usu. affecting children, caused by a bacillus (Bordetella pertussis) and characterised by a mucous discharge from the nose and later by repeated attacks of coughing that end in a forced intake of breath or whoop; whooping cough.
example_en: Whooping cough is commonly seen in children.

definition: a tube or pipe.
example_en: They fitted a pipe for the water to flow through.

definition: love; passion.
example_en: Passion grew between the two of them.

definition: a man who pays much attention for his appearance, dress, etc.
example_en: The dandy stood before the mirror for hours.

definition: a compelling or being compelled; coercion; constraint; compulsion.
example_en: They forced him into the agreement through coercion.

definition: a short cudgel.
example_en: The elder walked holding a short cudgel in his hand.

definition: to cause to increase (the number).
example_en: The army was increased with new soldiers.

definition: at all times; always; ever.
example_en: He always speaks only the truth.

definition: a plane figure having four angles and four sides, as a square, rectangle, trapezium; a quadrilateral.
example: ಮಗು ಚೌಕೋಣವನ್ನು ಕಾಗದದ ಮೇಲೆ ಎಳೆದು ಬಣ್ಣ ಹಾಕಿತು.
example_en: The child drew a quadrilateral on the paper and coloured it.

definition: (law) accession - a) addition to property by improvements or natural growth; b) the owner's right to the increase in value due to such additions.
example_en: Accession to the property came through the renovation of the house.

definition: the property, presentations, etc. that a woman is given by her husband or father-in-law at the time of her marriage.
example: ಮದುವೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ತಂದೆ ಮಗಳಿಗೆ ಓಲಿಯಾಗಿ ಒಡವೆ ಕೊಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: At the wedding, the father gave jewellery to his daughter as her marriage gift.

definition: the rheum of the eye.
example: ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ಎದ್ದಾಗ ಅವನ ಕಣ್ಣಲ್ಲಿ ಪುೞುಂಕು ತುಂಬಿತ್ತು.
example_en: When he woke up in the morning, his eyes were filled with rheum.

definition: to have a miscarriage; to abort.
example_en: She had a miscarriage due to the accident.

definition: a place to walk in.
example_en: There is a beautiful walking place in the garden.

definition: the shadow of an object that is thrown backward.
example: ಸೂರ್ಯಾಸ್ತದ ವೇಳೆ ಮರದ ಹಿನ್ನೆಳಲು ಉದ್ದವಾಗಿ ಬಿದ್ದಿತು.
example_en: At sunset, the tree's backward shadow fell long.

definition: an arrow made of flowerss (supposed to be of the Hindu Love-god, Manmata).
example_en: The poet described Manmatha's flower-arrow in the poem.

definition: to go as far as; to reach.
example: ರೈಲು ಸಂಜೆ ಆರು ಗಂಟೆಗೆ ಊರನ್ನು ಸೇರಿತು.
example_en: The train reached the town at six in the evening.

definition: a written statement, account, declaration, assertion or explanation.
example: ಆ ಒಪ್ಪಂದದ ವಕ್ಖಾಣ ಎಲ್ಲ ಸದಸ್ಯರಿಗೂ ಓದಿ ಹೇಳಲಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The written statement of that agreement was read out to all members.

definition: to take money on loan.
example_en: He took money on loan to build a house.

definition: a length equal to three feet (equal to thirty six inches).
example_en: There is a distance of three feet from the wall to the well.

definition: helping to produce, promote or maintain health; salutary; wholesome; healthful.
example_en: Green vegetables are wholesome food.

definition: a piece of grassland, whose grass is grown for use as hay; a meadow.
example_en: The farmer cut hay in the meadow.

definition: to flow violently and in flood; to rise, flow or gush out in or as in a flood.
example_en: The rainwater rose and flowed in flood through the canal.

definition: not referring to any person; not connected to any particular person; not personal.
example_en: The officer's decision was completely impersonal.

definition: a man who is diligent and puts forth steady effort (in a particular field); he who acts resolutely and energitically.
example: ವ್ಯವಸಾಯಿಯಾದ ರೈತ ಬೆಳಗಿನಿಂದ ಸಂಜೆಯವರೆಗೆ ಗದ್ದೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ದುಡಿದನು.
example_en: The diligent farmer toiled in the paddy field from morning until evening.

definition: absence of difficulty, impediment.
example_en: This work was completed without difficulty.

definition: a lean, emaciated man.
example_en: The lean, emaciated old man walked leaning on his staff.

definition: any hardened remains or imprints of plant or animal life of some previous geologic period, preserved in the earth's crust, including petrified wood, resin, etc.
example: ಆ ಬಂಡೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ ಸಸ್ಯದ ಪಳೆಯುಳಿಕೆ ಕಂಡುಬಂತು.
example_en: A fossil of an ancient plant was found in that rock.

definition: a hole; a chasm.
example_en: A hole was seen in the wall.

definition: to cause to jump, leap forward; to make something spring up or forward.
example_en: The boy made the ball spring up high.

definition: loving; feeling or expressing love.
example: ಆ ಪ್ರಣಯಿ ಯುವಕ ಅವಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಪದ್ಯ ಬರೆದನು.
example_en: That loving young man wrote a poem for her.

definition: to earn - a) to receive (salary, wages, etc.) for one's labour or service; b) to get or deserve as a result of something one has done; c) to gain (interest, etc.) as profit; d) to acquire; to have the possession of.
example_en: He worked hard and earned a good name.

definition: a leaf of a palmyra tree.
example_en: The village people wrote on a palmyra leaf and sent it.

definition: (pl.) a grand father and his father; (gen.) forefathers.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಪಜ್ಜ ಬಿಟ್ಟುಹೋದ ಆಸ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ನಾವು ಈಗಲೂ ಕಾಪಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದೇವೆ.
example_en: We still preserve the property left behind by our forefathers.

definition: the plant Hibiscus rosa-sinensis of Malvaceae family.
example: ಗುಡಿಯ ಮುಂದೆ ಪಿಚ್ಚಿ ಹೂವಿನ ಗಿಡ ಬೆಳೆಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
example_en: They have grown a hibiscus plant in front of the temple.

definition: a pair of fetters or shackles that is connected by a chain.
example_en: They put a pair of chained fetters on the prisoner and stood guard.

definition: (pl.) two fists.
example: ಅವನು ಇಪ್ಪಿಡಿ ಬಿಗಿ ಹಿಡಿದು ಹೋರಾಟಕ್ಕೆ ಸಿದ್ಧನಾದನು.
example_en: He clenched both his fists tightly and got ready to fight.

example_en: A beautiful pair of ornamental woven lines is visible at the border of the shawl my grandmother wove.

definition: an invitation for a dinner or a feast.
example: ಆ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಔತಣ ಇತ್ತು, ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಸೇರಿ ಊಟ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: There was a feast at that house, and everyone gathered to eat.

definition: the fine, dustlike mass of grains that are produced in the anthers or microspore sacs of seed plants, containing the male sexual cells (gametophytes) of the plant; pollen.
example_en: The bee collected the pollen of the flower.

definition: a shower of flowers.
example_en: A shower of flowers fell upon the hero.

definition: the forest area.
example_en: The hunters entered the forest area.

definition: an armour worn on the body.
example_en: The soldier wore the body armour before the battle.

definition: a man who that is moving downwards.
example_en: That downward-moving man was descending from the hill.

definition: again; once more.
example_en: The rain began to fall again.

definition: a wall surrounding a building.
example_en: There was a tall wall surrounding the house.

definition: the act of separating or a being separated; separation.
example_en: Everyone was saddened by their separation.

definition: land on either side and along a river; bank.
example_en: Children were playing on the bank of the river.

definition: a noble king.
example: ಆ ಉದಗ್ರಾವನಿಪ ತನ್ನ ಪ್ರಜೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರೀತಿಯಿಂದ ಕಾಪಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: That noble king protected his subjects with love.

definition: to have name; to be known by one's name.
example_en: That girl wishes to become known as a musician.

definition: to disappear within.
example_en: The thief disappeared within the crowd.

definition: a narrow room or passage.
example_en: It was even difficult to walk in that house's narrow passage.

definition: to polish a surface (of something) by rubbing, as to make (it) glossy.
example_en: He rubbed the bowl with a cloth to give it a polished shine.

definition: a member of the counselling committee; any person whose advice is sought; consultant; a counsel.
example: ಆ ಕೌಂಸಲದಾರ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಸಲಹೆ ಕೊಟ್ಟರು.
example_en: That counsellor gave good advice to everyone.

definition: a large, blazing flame.
example_en: A large, blazing flame was seen everywhere in the forest.

definition: going or running behind.
example_en: The child ran away scared of the dog's chasing.

definition: a woman who owns considerable extent of agricultural or farming land.
example_en: She is the well-known landowning woman of that village.

definition: she who stimulates, provokes.
example: ಆಕೆ ಯುವಕರಲ್ಲಿ ಕ್ರೀಡೆಗೆ ಉತ್ತೇಜಕಿಯಾಗಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: She worked as one who stimulates the youth towards sports.

definition: an instrument with a rule and a movable art for measuring angles and in fixing surfaces at an angle; a bevel square.
example_en: The carpenter measured the corner with a bevel square.

definition: to separate into parts; to divide.
example_en: The teacher divided the number into two parts.

definition: to become a nest, resting place or house.
example_en: That hollow became a nest for the bird.

definition: something that is supposed; a supposition.
example: ಅವನ ಮಾತು ಕೇವಲ ಆಧಾರಕಲ್ಪನೆ ಮಾತ್ರ, ಸತ್ಯವಲ್ಲ.
example_en: His statement is merely a supposition, not the truth.

definition: Śiva.
example_en: Worship of Ganaha (Śiva) is special in the month of Śrāvaṇa.

definition: (pl.) five petals (of a flower).
example_en: That rose flower had five petals.

definition: a machine or a mechanical device that is mobile.
example_en: The army had a new mobile machine.

definition: a job done or made without enough attention, precision, etc.; a careless work.
example: ಅವನು ಮಾಡಿದ್ದು ಬರೀ ಬಱುಮಾಟ, ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಗಮನ ಕೊಡಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: What he did was just careless work; he didn't pay proper attention.

definition: a bending or being bent.
example_en: A bending occurred in the iron rod.

definition: a long, thick beam bearing the weight of the roof of a building.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಮನೆಯ ಸರ ಗೆದ್ದಲು ಹಿಡಿದು ಶಿಥಿಲವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The roof beam of the old house had become weak due to termites.

definition: arranging; preparing; organising.
example_en: He organised the meeting methodically.

definition: the first stone laid at the foundation of a building; the foundation stone.
example_en: The chief minister laid the foundation stone of the hospital.

definition: an apparatus for drying by heating or blowing air; a dryer.
example_en: They bought a new dryer to dry clothes.

definition: a melodious tune; an agreeable sound.
example_en: The singer's song was full of a melodious tune.
